flatten_tensors: flatten a list of numpy tensors into a single 1D concatenated array
unflatten_tensors: unflatten a 1D numpy array back into a list of tensors with original shapes
pad_tensor: pad a numpy array to a specified maximum length using zero or last-value padding
concat_tensor_dict_list: concatenate a list of dictionaries containing numpy tensors along the first axis
stack_tensor_dict_list: stack a list of dictionaries of numpy tensors into a single dictionary of stacked tensors
